gloss: much the same; six of one, half a dozen of the other

definitions.gloss: much the same; about the same; six of one, half a dozen of the other
definitions.explanation: Used when two or more things are so similar that there is no meaningful difference between them. Often implies that none of the options is particularly good.

examples.japanese: ⟦どちらも→どちらも：08721_dochiramo⟧{似|に}たり{寄|よ}ったりだ。
⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{似|に}たり{寄|よ}ったりだった。
examples.english: The prices were about the same at every store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧{似|に}たり{寄|よ}ったりで、⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからなかった。
examples.english: The candidates' positions were all much the same, and I couldn't tell the difference.

notes:
Combines ⟦{似|に}→似る：01159_niru⟧たり (being similar) and ⟦{寄|よ}っ→寄る：02440_yoru⟧たり (being close), reinforcing the idea of near-identical similarity. The たり form of both verbs creates a rhythmic, set expression.

USAGE:
Often carries a slightly dismissive or negative nuance — implying that none of the options stands out or that they are all equally mediocre. Used as a predicate with だ or as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧{似|に}たり{寄|よ}ったり — they're all much the same
- {似|に}たり{寄|よ}ったり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ — similar results
- {似|に}たり{寄|よ}ったり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ — similar content

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大同小異|だいどうしょうい}→大同小異：07462_daidoushoui⟧ — much the same with minor differences (more formal, literary)
- {五十歩百歩|ごじっぽひゃっぽ} — pot calling the kettle black; equally bad (stronger negative nuance)
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ようなもの — about the same thing (plain, neutral)
